contexts.text: He overthrew those cities () = that all truths were separated from them... Cities = doctrinals... which are said to be overthrown, when there are falsities instead of truths...
Their altars ye shall overturn () = that the evil of that religiosity and the derivative worship are to be rejected... To overturn = to reject.
If anything resists... the Angels cast it down and overturn it by a mere effort of will, and a look. I have seen mountains... thus cast down and overturned...
Evils are here called destroyers by night (). ( = both falsities and evils. AE 919:end.)
The overthrow of God () = damnation to Hell. AE 1029:14.
